target_customer: Engineering and platform teams at software companies that run incidents, CI/CD and observability across many tools
problem: Engineers lose time searching and correlating across observability, CI/CD and infrastructure tools during incidents and release work. OneGrep is an agent that automates these tasks, such as runbook automation during incidents, and helps reduce observability costs.

founders.name: Achintya Ashok
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: tech lead of the Disney Streaming search team serving 70M customers. The YC company description lists Amazon rather than Goldman Sachs elsewhere; the page is internally inconsistent.

founders.name: Brian Cripe
founders.background_notes: Per YC page: more than a decade in developer tools, distributed systems and real-time analytics; founding engineer on Amazon's incident management platform.

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must integrate with many observability and CI/CD tools and act safely in production environments, which is hard for a two person team even with LLM APIs.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations and runbook knowledge can lock in customers, but the underlying agent approach was open to well funded entrants and incumbents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later coverage (2025 and 2026) shows a crowded AI SRE category with Resolve AI, Cleric and Traversal and incident tools adding runbooks. No dated 2024 source was found, and no acquisition of OneGrep was found.

market_need_then: On-call and incident work is a recognized cost for engineering teams and LLM agents made automation of investigative steps plausible in 2023 and 2024. No company specific demand evidence was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses onegrep.dev, not a .com. Date not found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand coverage found; name nods to the Unix grep command (inference, no source states it) which signals a developer audience.

outcome_analysis: OneGrep is an active two person YC Winter 2024 company from founders with large company infrastructure experience at Disney Streaming, Amazon and Coinbase. No verified funding beyond YC, no traction figures and no exit were found. The AI SRE category later became crowded with better funded entrants, so execution speed and integration depth are the open questions.
notes: Company website onegrep.dev returned HTTP 503 on fetch; not worked around. Funding unverified: aggregators list about $500K (CB Insights seed dated May 2024, VCBacked pre-seed April 2024, Transpose Platform named as investor) while yespress lists $130,000 seed in March 2024. Conflicting and no primary source, so no round is recorded. Competitor search found only 2025 and 2026 coverage with no dated competitor near the batch, so the list is empty. Re-checked: search found CB Insights (seed May 15, 2024 and a convertible note January 2024, about 500K total with Transpose Platform and Innovation Endeavors named), VCBacked, Employbl and YesPress (130K seed); all aggregators or profile sites that conflict, so the funding stays unverified and unrecorded. VCBacked and Employbl label the April 2024 round pre-seed and yespress gives 130K, so stage, date and amount conflict and are unconfirmed.
